requiredRegressionReview.evidence: Stored undefined hit checks no factory and deletion from old cache only. No assertion that key survives in current cache or subsequent eviction proves refresh; a dropped old entry could pass. Historical corresponding test also asserted has(old), which this delivered test omits.

Expired entry, one factory call and one eviction are checked. Remaining TTL is only compared >10, accepting Infinity; no finite/default upper bound or later expiry. Same loss-of-default-TTL diagnostic prepared.
Original thrown Error and empty cache retained; object key strictly passed to factory, repeat hit avoids factory, separate cache and distinct object key use separate values.
